Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.description: How the platform handles personal data.
Privacy.draftText: This page describes how the platform works. The final text, approved by the organisation responsible, will be published before the courses begin.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.text: {name} is run by [NAME OF THE ORGANISATION], which is responsible for the personal data collected on this site. Contact: [CONTACT EMAIL].

data.title: What we collect
data.text: When you request information: your name, your email and, if you give them, your organisation, the course you are interested in and your message. When you have an account: name, email, preferred language and the courses you are enrolled in. We do not collect browsing data for advertising and we use no third-party analytics.

purpose.title: What we use it for
purpose.text: To answer your request, send you an invitation and give you access to the materials of your courses. We do not sell your data or pass it on for other purposes.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: We only use the cookies the site needs to work: to keep you signed in and to remember the language you chose. We use no advertising cookies.

thirdParties.title: Content from other services
thirdParties.text: Some materials are YouTube or Vimeo videos, or Google documents. That content is only loaded when you choose to open it; from then on the privacy policy of that service also applies.

storage.title: Where it is kept
storage.text: The data is kept on servers in the European Union, with access restricted to the trainers. [CONFIRM PROVIDER AND REGION]

retention.title: For how long
retention.text: We keep information requests for as long as it takes to answer them, and accounts for as long as you take part in the courses. [PERIODS TO BE DEFINED]

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or withdraw your consent, by writing to the contact above. You can also lodge a complaint with your data protection authority (in Portugal, the CNPD).
